notes.title: Update and release on Android
notes.content:
Two years after the release of arcade debut, Vectro Blast, the developers from Sagittaras Games are coming out with a series of updates. They promise not only more modern visuals, but also a change in game mechanics, a new soundtrack and most importantly, a port to Android for mobile gamers.

You can look forward to a new look of enemies, plenty of options for upgrading your ship and weapons, and of course hours and hours of fun. Your mission is just to survive and reach the highest score as possible you can and become a legend on our leaderboard. At the end of each mission, a final boss will awaits you to test your skills.

[previewyoutube=C_hAJV2Gs4A;full][/previewyoutube]
Don't hesitate and take advantage of the 50% launch discount now. We wish you a good luck, because you're going to need it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890711/3997bfddc513dc4614153b8b9eb65ba831cc2c22.png

notes.title: Customize the game controls
notes.content:
Starting today, we will be releasing a series of regular updates for our game.

Due to a Holiday season, this update doesn’t contain a lot of changes. 
The rest of the updates will be coming in monthly intervals and you’ll be getting more new features, or fixes.

Controls change
Controls are now customizable, and you can also choose from a couple of new ways to control your game.
You can now switch between the guns in one direction, up or down. This setting is linked to the back/forward buttons on your mouse by default. This means you can change your weapons with your mouse on the fly, if you have those buttons.

Unfortunately, the option to control your game with a gamepad has not been finished yet.
We’re hoping to bring you this feature in the next updates!

Bugfixes

 The Seekers description in the update menu wasn’t centered.
 The in-game settings background was darkened.
 The Clone Squares cloning effect was reduced: It could cause the game running slow on lower end machines.
 Rarely, the game could be showing zero heath, but you were still alive.
 Added a prevention for getting stuck in a wall.


The next update is coming in January, and one of the main features is going to be a localization support, but you can expect a couple of other cool updates as well!

notes.title: Elite Enemies
notes.content:
Things are more interesting when they get complicated, right? We think the same! An Infinite amount of regular enemies is just boring… So why not more.

Each 10th wave, regardless of the current battle situation, an elite enemy is spawned. The enemy excels with tough defense and strong unique offense system. Elite enemies are the real challenge for you.  You will get a great reward for beating each one of them.  Decent amount of ammo, more upgrade tokens and higher change for heal token, than from regular enemies. If there are more enemies in the battlefield, they get killed along with the elite.

Let’s take a closer look at our elite enemies.

Laser Cross
So who is this guy? First enemy is the so-called Laser Cross. Construction of the ship is a cross with 4 diamonds. The first phase the ship is protected by a shield. In this phase the ship is chasing you.

Ship will turn on the laser with a pulse three times. It’s a lot of damage but it requires a lot of energy. So after 3 shots the ship is stunned for a moment, then it goes back to a defensive state. 

TIP: Try to keep an eye on this elite’s rotation movement. And fly between the ship's edges.

Rocket Thing
Yeah this is our little “Rocketman”, it’s basically just a turret. It stays in it’s spawn location, but likes to keep turning to your position.

This elite fires a lot of missiles at your position then takes a nap. Well he is actually reloading his ammunition, but you don’t need to know the details. In this state he doesn’t care about you at all.

His orange weapons however are harmless so you should focus fire at the blue parts of the ship.

TIP: Try to keep enough distance between this elite so you can manage to move around the turret for the entire duration of it’s firing phase.

Which one of these two elites is making you more nervous in the battlefield? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Know your Weapons
notes.content:
On your long way for your master score you will definitely want to use your weapon arsenal efficiently. To figure out which weapon to use in different situations can be quite a challenge.

You can switch between 3 weapons and all of them are available for you right from the beginning. However now the tricky part: weapon 2 and 3 have limited ammo.

You will find ammo either from each elite which spawns each 10 waves or if you will be very lucky it can also drop from classic enemies. 

Machine Gun
The only weapon you can use as much as you want. It has unlimited ammo and keeps firing in the direction where your cursor is currently moving.

Upgrading the Machine Gun will increase its damage and attack speed.

Refractor
Lasers should be in each solid weapon arsenal so we have them! Similarly to Machine Gun it keeps firing in the direction where your cursor is, however the range for shooting is limited. Useful thing to know is that you don’t have to be as precise like with the Machine Gun.

Still not awesome enough? You are right. When the beam hits a target, it can split to 4 more enemies. So it is very useful if you are in a bad situation. For example surrounded by squares or stressed out by arrows.

Upgrading Refractor does not only increase damage and attack speed, but also the radius, where enemies can be hit.

Seekers
Homing rocket missiles! Now we are talking! If more enemies are chasing you, homing rockets can get to the right use, because you don’t have to aim at all. It shoots 3 missiles on the nearest enemies. However the radius is even smaller than for Refractor.

Upgrading Seekers will increase your damage, attack speed and most importantly the radius  where the missiles can hit the target.

If you are using Machine Gun only, we strongly recommend you to try the other ones as well. Key to a very high score has two aspects: mastering your movement of how different enemies behave and learning how to use all of your three weapons efficiently.

If you are struggling with elites don’t worry. In the next episode of Vectro’s Handbook we will take a look on elite enemies.

notes.title: Prepare your gamepads and enjoy the live-show!
notes.content:
The game is out for a week now, but we are still trying to get you news about what is up next.

What we will improve
Mouse and keyboard, not enough?
Not everyone likes to play with a mouse and keyboard, especially fans of our genre.  So prepare your gamepads, because Vectro Blast will soon support gamepad devices (including menu moving).

Localization
We also want to think about players from our country. So we plan to add czech language option in the future. Even some other languages might be added in the future, if we will get some requests.

Of course we will also work on bugs that might appear later. Full patch nodes will be available in the first week of december.

Vectro Blast Being Streamed!
We understand it can be hard to decide which new game to try. Because of that, we are putting a lot of efforts to contact as many streamers as possible, so you can get live feedback from your favorite streamers.

First streamer who is going to help us with this and try the game live is Toren - Czech YouTuber and Streamer.

Go and check his Twitch!

We hope that we will be able to show you more live feedbacks from streamers and not only from czech community.

notes.title: Meet your Enemies
notes.content:
Vectro Blast world is simple and minimalistic. Enemies might look simple as well, but they are not! You will face six different enemy types. Each one has a unique look as well as a unique playstyle. 

Roamers
Roamer enemy types do not actually care about you… They just move around the map in a greater amount.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890711/e0684ed0c7a60023288e620d90bf3a259d5a2050.png
They are round and red. Circloids move in a circle again and again… Is that all? Well, Circloids can also change the direction of the way, which they are currently facing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890711/14d2907d618d57b0df98959a271cd43cefc567b3.png
Remember, when we said, that Roamer enemy types don’t care about you? Well these Diamonds are your big fans! They will fly straight to you and you can be sure they want your autograph. Seeking Diamonds come from the portal and in a group. They are very familiar with kamikaze tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890711/883f508b8512d12a65853f75999adcee3e5c390e.png
Blue squares, which move from one map’s edge to another… They also like copy/paste tricks.. If you will not kill them when they spawn, you will soon find yourself surrounded by the clones. However their power does not grow with higher waves besides score points, which do.

Shooters
These guys actually care about you a lot. Their goal is simple: Revenge for the death of the poor roamers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890711/29190f2303ed99edd2d730bf4715ecda7c1a4170.png
Orange arrows, which spawn in a small group have one job: Aim, shoot and ask later. They like to keep you close and when they see a chance to shoot, they shoot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890711/11db14ee7699d72ebfda918663c975b549c91b48.png
Last but not least… Miners! Finally Shooter enemy type who does not care where you are. They love to live at peace, with their 348 mines laying everywhere.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890711/98d2674de46be9a109ca3041bc02d8dd033d0fea.png
If you will get that far, Octagon Tower will be your new friend for nights. You can swear, scream, tell us to remove him, but that is pretty much all you can do about it.

What does it do? Well it is a tower, if you have not figured that out by name. So it won’t move, but trust us, you will still hate it. They like to rotate and constantly shoot in 8 directions. Yeah you want them dead ASAP!

Each new enemy is more annoying than the older. You need to watch your step and cleverly decide which enemy to shoot first. 

In the next episode of Vectro’s Handbook we will take a closer look at weapons you can use.

notes.title: Vectro Blast is waiting for you!
notes.content:
Get yourself some energy drinks and make your keyboard ready. Go back to the days, where there was only one job in games: Get the best score possible!

Vectro Blast is an old school arcade game, extended with features for upgrading your ship. Your leaderboard’s position will be frequently changing, because of the player’s competition. For the best way to dominate the online ladder, you should keep collecting upgrade tokens as much as possible and keep upgrading ship’s attributes.

This release is of course just a start of our adventure. We cannot wait for your feedback, so we will better know what should be changed or added into the game with further patches.
In the upcoming weeks we will also share with you more details about enemies in the game, including their description and our tips on how to fight them.

Let’s get into the cockpit and start shooting!
